title: Changing a copied value makes the tier's own rules
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, the first tier after Default, on Same as previous tier in matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, two ranges, Default Margin % 40 then 32.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 38 in tier A's first range.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Type 45 in Default's first range after clicking Edit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.
  • Tier A reads Uses previous tier.

Step 3:

  • Tier A's cells show Default's 40 and 32.

Step 4:

  • Tier A's first range reads 38.

Step 5:

  • In view tier A reads 38% margin and 32% margin as its own rules.

Step 6:

  • Tier A keeps 38 and 32 when Default changes to 45.
